name: HCM — Scenario 3: Weekly Finance Prompt
description: Every Friday at 4:00 PM, send a Discord reminder to export Xero records.

parameters.content: 🟢 Finance check: Have you exported this week's Xero invoices to D.02 ACCOUNTS PAYABLE?

setup_notes.step_1: Replace PASTE_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL_HERE with your Discord webhook URL (same channel as Scenario 1, or a dedicated #finance-reminders channel).
setup_notes.step_2: This scenario has no conditions — it fires every Friday regardless. That is intentional.
setup_notes.test_instructions: Change the schedule to 'run once in 1 minute' to test. Verify the Discord message appears. Switch back to weekly Friday 4:00 PM after confirming.
